USER GUIDE
1. WHAT IS THIS MANIPULATIVE?
GEOMETRIC AREA MODEL. MULTIPLY BY DIMENSION.
Quadratic equations are not abstract pencil symbols.Polynomial tiles model multiplication geometrically: Area = Length × Width = (x + a)(x + b)Arranging tiles into a solid rectangle proves thatfactoring a trinomial is literally un-multiplying area!
CALIBRATED POLYNOMIAL DATUM {xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n
DUAL-STAGE FACTORING LID & L-RAILS
Slide the two L-rails into the lid's precision channels toanchor the Cartesian origin. Align x-rods and unit tilesflush against rails to read binomial factors instantly!
AREA MODEL: (x + 3)(x + 2) = x² + 5x + 6
x+2 x + 3
+x²

SOLID RECTANGLE Zero gaps, zero overlaps Linear: 3x + 2x = 5x Constant: 3 × 2 = 6 Un-multiplying area!

3. WHY KEEP THIS REFERENCE CARD?
✓ NO LOST PIECE LEFT BEHIND
Classroom manipulatives get lost. Never abandon an incomplete set! Every individual math component is permanently stocked for single replacements.
Scan back QR or visit stackcalc.io/parts Order individual replacement pieces anytime
✓ 10-SECOND SELF-CHECKING PACK-UP
Pack-up is a built-in math game! Lay the two x² tiles flat onthe box floor, slot the 10 x-rods in side bays, and stack the 18unit cubes in center bays. L-rails snap securely into lid retention.Lid latches firmly for silent, rattle-free carry.
✓ HANDS-ON TUTORIAL ON REVERSE
Flip this card over for a complete step-by-step hands-on lesson with concrete numbers, stage arrangements, calculator cross-references, and core mathematical principle breakthrough! Keep this card stored inside the box lid!
